name: QuestionnaireState

test_list.description: No named option, NoneOfTheAbove or text answer is preselected.
Every choice question offers explicit NoneOfTheAbove; selecting it clears named options and selecting a named option clears None.
Space toggles a named option while preserving other selected options.
Batch preparation validates all required questions and encodes optional missing answers as Unanswered.
Required free text must be nonblank; notes remain optional.
Navigation retains each question’s answer and notes, with explicit notes focus.
Per-field byte overflow rejects and preserves the editable field.
A single choice has at most one named option and None is mutually exclusive.
Aggregate answer bytes are capped and overflow does not truncate or mutate the field.
Reject more than eight questions or sixteen named options per question.
Count metadata across the entire request against the bounded request estimate.
Oversized selected IDs reject batch preparation while preserving selections and reporting exhausted answer budget.

dependencies: none; pure presentation state; no SDK/kernel human-request protocol

inputs.name: request
inputs.description: Immutable request identity/revision and question availability snapshot.

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: UI-local key semantic or text edit.

output_description: Pure questionnaire draft plus an atomically validated answer batch; no domain dispatch, cancellation, or authorization.
